name: CCF Summer Programs
description_short: Connecting for Children & Families, a Woonsocket non-profit, runs three summer camps by grade: Camp Discovery (K-2), Chillin' and Skillin' (3-5) and Get Connected (6-8). The camps run for six weeks, from July through mid-August.
